name: Seireisai
source:
This story's protagonist suddenly finds a young witch in his house. That witch's name is Echo, and she has come to witness a special event which is supposed to occur in seven days. The protagonist allows Echo to live with him in the meantime, enjoying life with her while also growing closer to his colleague, Nami Kiuchi, whom he takes the train to work with.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/267863/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
故事的主人公突然发现自己家里闯进了一名年轻魔女。魔女名叫艾可，此行是为了亲眼见证七天后即将发生的一场特殊盛事。在此期间，主人公收留艾可住进自己家中；在享受与她同居生活的同时，他也与每天一同搭电车通勤的女同事木内奈美越走越近。

[摘自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/267863/]MobyGames[/url]]
